summary: Iter-36 frontend-only verification of Verdict Accuracy v2 (calibration breadcrumbs) + Backtest beginner-friendly explainer + marketing reflection on WhyUs/Technical pages. All 8 acceptance scenarios PASS. Marketing-claims jest regression remains 19/19 green in 0.9s.

test1_whyus_calibrated_confidence_card.details: Note: route is /why (not /why-us as stated in request) — visiting /why-us 302s to /dashboard for authed users. On /why, MODULES list renders the new 'Calibrated Confidence' card with Award icon, 'Available' badge, and full body containing 'Earnings-Proximity Gate' AND 'RF-Disagreement Penalty'. Verified via document.body.innerText scan: hasCC=True hasEG=True hasRF=True. No console errors.

test2_technical_confidence_calibration_r.details: [data-testid='confidence-calibration-rules'] rendered at #confidence anchor (innerText length 888 chars). Rule 1 · Earnings-Proximity Gate and Rule 2 · RF-Disagreement Penalty cards both visible. No console errors.

test3_backtest_how_it_works_explainer.details: [data-testid='backtest-how-it-works'] visible. Heading 'Imagine you had $10,000 and acted on every Neulab verdict the moment it landed.' present. [data-testid='backtest-rules-grid'] contains exactly 4 numbered cards in correct order: 1=Entry, 2=Exit, 3=Cash buffer, 4=Benchmark. Each card has paragraph beginning with the title.

test4_backtest_empty_state_rf_hint.details: Fresh user (registered via POST /api/auth/register with full_name) plus admin /unlock 1h to bypass the FREE-plan upgrade-gate (free users see 'Unlock your personal track record' Pro/Elite gate FIRST, never the empty state). After unlock, the gated user sees 'NOT ENOUGH VERDICTS YET' eyebrow, heading 'Run at least 3 analyses to unlock your backtest.', subtext 'You have 0 verdicts so far…', and the new ML-fallback hint paragraph: 'Want to see what the result looks like before you build your own history? Scroll down to the ML Backtest below — it replays the Random-Forest secondary-opinion model on the last 12 months of price action and shows real win-rate numbers right now.' Both 'Not enough verdicts' and 'Random-Forest secondary-opinion model' substrings confirmed in DOM. CTA 'Run an analysis →' present.

test5_analysis_verdict_module_conditiona.details: Logged in as admin (jolor69). On /analysis/AAPL: [data-testid='verdict-module']=1 visible, [data-testid='confidence-calibration-breadcrumbs']=0 (correct no-op — legacy verdict predates this PR and has no confidence_adjustments field). UI handles missing field gracefully — no error rendered, no empty card. Zero error-class elements on page. /analysis/MSFT shows 'NO VERDICT ON FILE' (admin has no MSFT verdict yet) — also handled gracefully.

test6_mobile_390_no_overflow_single_colu.details: Viewport 390x844 on /backtest: document.body.scrollWidth = 390 (no horizontal overflow). [data-testid='backtest-rules-grid'] computed gridTemplateColumns = '308px' (single column). All 4 cards stack vertically.

test7_tablet_768_two_columns_md_breakpoi.details: Viewport 768x1024 on /backtest: gridTemplateColumns = '321px 321px' → 2 columns confirmed at md+ breakpoint.

test8_marketing_claims_jest_regression.details: cd /app/frontend && CI=1 yarn test --testPathPattern=marketing-claims --watchAll=false → 19/19 passed in 0.898s, exit code 0. No regression from this PR.

critical_code_review_comments: Conditional rendering for [data-testid='confidence-calibration-breadcrumbs'] is correctly gated on (analysis.confidence_adjustments?.length > 0). Legacy verdicts without the field render the verdict ring with no empty card — correct UX, verified live on admin's existing AAPL verdict.

BacktestPage empty-state copy mentions 'Run at least 3 analyses' (heading) but the request said 'min_required=10'. The actual gate value is 3 (visible in heading + the 'You have 0 verdicts so far' subtext). Either the request was outdated or product reduced the threshold — non-blocking, just a docs/spec mismatch worth flagging.
WhyUsPage route is /why not /why-us (App.js:93 path=/why). The review request says '/why-us' which would 302 to /dashboard for authed users. Just a doc nit — the page itself works correctly.

Free-plan users on /backtest see the 'Unlock your personal track record' Pro/Elite upgrade gate BEFORE any empty-state messaging — they never reach the new ML-fallback hint paragraph. This is correct gating order (paywall first, then content states). Testing the empty-state requires a Pro/Elite user (or admin /unlock) with verdict_count < 3.
Mobile responsiveness clean: no overflow at 390px, grid stacks 1 column on mobile and 2 columns at 768px+ (md). Card readability good in both viewports.
Pre-existing (NOT this PR): /pricing still emits React duplicate-key warning ('quick_actions') noted in iter-31/34/35. Unrelated.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verdict-Accuracy-v2 + Backtest explainer ships clean. Important nuances for re-test: (1) WhyUs route is /why NOT /why-us — /why-us redirects to /dashboard for authed users. (2) BacktestPage empty-state requires a non-free plan with verdict_count<3 — free users see the upgrade gate first. Use POST /api/admin/users/{id}/unlock {duration:'1h'} to test it. (3) The new confidence-calibration-breadcrumbs block is conditional — legacy verdicts predating this PR have no confidence_adjustments and render no breadcrumb (correct no-op). To force the breadcrumb to render in UI, run a fresh /api/analysis/{TICKER}/start?mode=hybrid where the ticker has earnings within 7 days OR RF disagrees with Claude — the calibrate_verdict path will populate confidence_adjustments.
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects found. All 8 review-request scenarios pass. The conditional verdict-breadcrumb rendering is implemented correctly (graceful absence on legacy data), all marketing copy lands on the correct pages, the Backtest 4-card explainer is in spec (correct order, correct labels, correct mobile/tablet stacking), the empty-state RF-fallback hint paragraph contains the exact 'Random-Forest secondary-opinion model' phrase, and the marketing-claims jest suite remains 19/19 green.
